title: Stay on 30A Property Management: Palm Paradise in Seacrest Beach – Stay on 30A
meta_description: Stay on 30A Property Management: Palm Paradise in Seacrest Beach. Welcome to Palm Paradise by Stay on 30a, a luxury, modern coastal home! This oasis is nestled conveniently between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach in the Seacrest Beach neighborhood.
description_expanded: class="property_description"> Welcome to "Palm Paradise," an elevated Seacrest Beach retreat. Perfectly positioned right on Scenic 30A and just steps from the Village Town Center, this beautifully designed coastal home offers the ultimate blend of walkability, comfort, and elevated vacation living. Nestled between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach,  Palm Paradise  places world-class dining, boutique shopping, and iconic 30A charm right outside your door while still offering the peaceful feeling of a private getaway. Inside, you’ll find designer finishes and thoughtful details throughout, creating a space that feels both sophisticated and effortlessly welcoming. The home features four bedrooms, including two king primary suites, offering the ideal layout for families and groups seeking a balance of connection and privacy. The chef-inspired kitchen with quartz countertops and custom finishes flows seamlessly into the main living space, anchored by a cozy gas fireplace, perfect for relaxed evenings after beach days or sunset rides along 30A. One of the standout features of  Palm Paradise  is the game room with bunks and its own kitchenette, providing an additional space to spread out, entertain, or create the perfect “kids’ retreat” while the rest of the group unwinds upstairs. Step outside to enjoy multiple private balconies, each offering ample seating and inviting places to gather. For the best views, head to the third-floor balcony featuring stunning Gulf views, an unforgettable backdrop for morning coffee, golden-hour conversations, and quiet coastal moments. Outdoor living is just as thoughtfully designed. Fire up the grill, then enjoy dinner together on the patio dining space, ideal for al fresco meals and easy evenings under the stars. As a guest, you’ll enjoy inclusive access to Seacrest’s community pools and private beach access, making beach days effortless and poolside afternoons just as inviting. With six complimentary bikes included, exploring 30A’s scenic paths and neighboring coastal communities is as easy as stepping outside. Whether you’re spending the day at the beach, walking to coffee and dinner in the Village Town Center, or cruising to Rosemary and Alys Beach,  Palm Paradise  offers a luxury 30A experience that feels easy, elevated, and unforgettable. HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Private Deeded Beach Access -Resort-Style Community Pool One Block from Home -6 Adult Bikes -4 Private Balconies with Seating -Gulf Views from Third Floor Balcony -Smart TVs in each Bedroom -Full Sized Washer & Dryer -Dedicated Workspace -Gas Fireplace -Gas Grill & Outdoor Dining -Beach Gear including Pool Towels, Chairs, Umbrellas, Boogie Boards, Toys & Coolers -3 Dedicated Parking Spots with Additional Parking Available Throughout the Community -Beach Tram Stop Close to Home ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 14 4 Bedrooms / 4 Baths FIRST FLOOR: -Bedroom 1: Full over Full Bunk with Full Trundle -Game Room -Kitchenette -Full Bath SECOND FLOOR: -Bedroom 2: King Bed -Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa THIRD FLOOR: -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath -Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Bath **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Three parking spaces available (3 driveway). Overflow available throughout the community first come first serve. Passes are required which will be provided by Seacrest security. Included are 6 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. SEACREST BEACH COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS: Seacrest Beach is one of the charming coastal communities that sits on 30A nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Within the Seacrest community, there is a private beach and just 2 blocks away is the largest resort style family-friendly pool in Northern Florida with over 12,000 square feet of crystal-clear water. When you re ready to take a break from the pool and beach be sure to visit Peddlers Pavilion. Peddlers Pavilion is located in Seacrest Beach and is a collection of fun and unique businesses. Here you will find boutiques offering coastal attire to handmade jewelry. There are also some great local spots for dining. For additional entertainment shopping, dining and local events, take the Scenic 30A bike path to nearby Rosemary Beach, Florida. **Please Note:** *Seacrest Beach does not allow golf cart rentals. AMENITY ACCESS In order to park and have access to Seacrest Beach amenities, guests are required to complete the online Seacrest Beach HOA Guest Registration packet, prior to their arrival. A link will be sent after the reservation is made. Upon arrival, you can pick up your parking passes and wristbands at the Guest Service Window by the lagoon pool. Guests can enter the lagoon area amenity complex at any of the six gates. There will be a queue outside of the Guest Services office marked by safety yellow beach umbrellas. BEACH ACCESS 1. Seacrest Beach community features a private beach on the south side of 30A. There are tram stops though out the community that operate on demand. Upon entering the beach to the left (east), there is onsite chair rental service. La Dolce Vita is the exclusive provider at Seacrest Beach. Guests may bring their own chairs to the beach for set up on the right (west) side of the beach. Prohibited items at the private beach access: wagons, wheeled coolers, tents, and canopies. 2. Inlet Beach Public Access. This access has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. Located at the end of South Orange Street about 200 yards south of US Hwy 98. Inlet Beach Regional Access is the largest county access and features three dune walkovers and 117 parking spaces. This beach access is one of our personal favorites and a short 10 minute bike ride away! HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. *No parties or events. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *This home must remain pet free! IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a . Both should be uploaded to our Happy Stays app. read more + less -
